A '''Dust devil (elite)''' is an [[elite monster|elite version]] of the [[dust devil]]. If on a [[Slayer assignment]], an elite Dust devil is guaranteed to spawn; otherwise, elite monsters have a spawn rate of 1 in 1,000. Elite spawn rates can be further increased with the use of [[fellstalk incense stick]]s and tier 2 [[luck]]. 

Unlike its normal counterparts, It will occasionally stun the player for 3 seconds at a time, so having [[Freedom]] and [[Anticipation]] will come in handy when facing it.
